p: Zhimao Low-Altitude is a professional incubation park for the low-altitude economy in Yantian. It focuses on the "low-altitude + digital economy" track, and it discovers, invests in, and nurtures high-quality tech SMEs and scale enterprises in industries such as low-altitude economy and digital economy. We support companies' incubation and growth across the board through a three-in-one model of "investment + services + resources." Yantian has launched a 100 million yuan low-altitude fund to inject core capital into low-altitude economy companies in the park. The park roof is planned for a low-altitude transport takeoff and landing hub, and the district is actively pushing for airspace opening. From funding and infrastructure to policy resources, it provides end-to-end support for company operations.
pc: 智茂低空是盐田低空经济专业级孵化园区。聚焦“低空+数字经济”赛道，发掘、投资和培育优质低空经济+数字经济等产业的科技型中小企业及规模企业。我们以“投资+服务+资源”三位一体赋能模式，全方位助力企业孵化与成长。盐田已发起设立 1 亿元低空基金，为园区内低空经济企业发展注入核心资本动力；园区楼顶规划建设低空交通起降枢纽，并积极推动空域开放，从资金、基础设施到政策资源，为企业运营提供全链条保障。
